رَاعِبٌ and ↓ رَعَّابٌ , [but the latter is an intensive epithet, or denotes habit, or frequency,] One who threatens; a threatener. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- One who charms, or fascinates, by magical enchantment [or by the eye] or otherwise. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- One who composes, or utters, the rhyming prose termed رَعْبٌ. (K, TA.) ―
-b4- Also the former (راعب), A torrent that fills the valley: (S:) or (tropical:) that frightens by its abundance and its width and its filling the valley. (A.) It is applied also to rain. (TA.) And A valley filled with water. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
